title.en: Two superconducting states share one material
title.zh: 一种材料里，两种超导状态共存

summary.en: Cornell researchers mapped two competing superconducting components in uranium ditelluride. One fades on further cooling; its possible topological character remains an open question.
summary.zh: 康奈尔研究人员绘出二碲化铀中两种相互竞争的超导组分，其中一种随进一步冷却消退；其拓扑性质仍待确定。

title.zh: 培训内容相同，开场用词不同

summary.en: A Cornell study reports that alternative introductory language improved Republicans’ enthusiasm for the same diversity training. The measured result concerns attitudes.
summary.zh: 康奈尔研究报告，以替代词语介绍相同多元化培训，提高了共和党参与者的热情；研究测量的是态度。
